headline: 亞莉安娜宣布暫別螢光幕
context: 美國歌手亞莉安娜．格蘭德（Ariana Grande）在世界巡演下月結束後，將「暫時淡出公眾視野」。她在芝加哥演唱會上向歌迷說明，這個決定是她很早以前就悄悄計劃好的，不是一時衝動。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Singer and actor, whose world tour ends next month, told audience in Chicago that she had been quietly planning the move for a long time Ariana Grande has expanded upon her recent decision to take “a step back from visibility” when her tour ends next month, as a result of what a spokesperson called “endless, ongoing public scrutiny”. On Monday night during the first show of a three-night run in Chicago, the 33-year-old musician and actor read from notes as she told fans: “The announcement that was made yesterday was not a reactive or impulsive thing. It is something that I had decided to plan quietly, a long time ago.” Continue reading...
sources.title: Ariana Grande expands on decision to ‘step back from visibility’, telling fans it was ‘not reactive or impulsive’

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Grande “will be taking a step back from visibility” after her Eternal Sunshine Tour concludes next month, a spokeswoman for the singer said on Sunday.
sources.title: Ariana Grande to Step Away From Public Life After Tour Concludes

thread_text:
美國歌手亞莉安娜．格蘭德（Ariana Grande）宣布，她的世界巡演下月結束後，將「暫時淡出公眾視野」。她在芝加哥演唱會上向歌迷說明，這是她很早以前就悄悄計劃好的決定，不是臨時起意。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美國歌手亞莉安娜．格蘭德（Ariana Grande）宣布，她的世界巡演「永恆的陽光」（Eternal Sunshine Tour）下月結束後，將「暫時淡出公眾視野」。她的發言人形容，這個決定與她長期承受的「無止盡公眾審視」有關。週一晚間，格蘭德在芝加哥連續三場演唱會的首場上，對著台下歌迷唸出手中的筆記說：「昨天公布的消息，不是一時衝動，是我很早以前就悄悄計劃好的決定。」

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日至 5 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 亞莉安娜．格蘭德要暫時淡出公眾視野了。她的世界巡演下個月結束，之後她會先退到幕後一段時間。週一晚上，在芝加哥的演唱會上，她親口跟歌迷解釋，這不是一時衝動，是她很早以前就悄悄計劃好的決定。
